title: Henri IV to Landgrave Maurice of Hesse-Kassel, ciphered passages printed in Rommel 1840

steps.what: Located cipher pages by digit density in the IA hOCR; fetched full-resolution page images.
Rommel's 1846 key (Allg. Zeitschrift f. Geschichte V, 402-403).
About 4,100 groups transcribed by eye with diacritics and glyphs.
Decode of the 3 Apr 1604 letter matches Rommel's 1846 clear text word for word.
All seven passages decoded and read; list misalignments in the print fixed from the texts.
Framing corrected: Rommel's key 'never applied' becomes 'no published application' after Lasry's note on overclaiming.

outcome.method_basis: The key is the one Rommel published in 1846 (Allgemeine Zeitschrift für Geschichte V, pp. 402-403) for the Henri IV-Maurice correspondence; the project transcribed the undeciphered figures from Rommel's 1840 edition and decoded them, correcting misplaced entries in the printed key.
outcome.notes: Open: nine groups p. 213, seven at top of p. 307, name 98_, a letter run on p. 311, stray garbled groups.

prior.where: Rommel 1846 printed the key and a clear text of the 3 Apr 1604 letter only; his 1840 'Passages déchiffrés' glossary guesses some phrases

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
